sets.transcript_en: Good morning, everyone. This is a reminder that the building's fire drill will take place tomorrow at 10:15 a.m. When the alarm sounds, please leave your desks immediately and exit through the nearest stairwell. Do not use the elevators. Assembly Point B is located in the north parking lot near the flagpole. Department supervisors should bring their attendance sheets. If you have mobility concerns, contact Facilities today so we can arrange assistance. Thank you for your cooperation.
sets.transcript_zh: 各位早上好。提醒大家：大楼消防演习将于明天上午 10:15 举行。警报响起后，请立即离开座位，从最近的楼梯间撤离，不要使用电梯。集合点 B 位于北停车场旗杆附近。各部门主管请携带考勤表。如有行动不便，请于今日联系后勤部以便安排协助。感谢配合。
